milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The torch is at spawn-relative (0, 2, -10) on an oak fence post, 10 blocks north of spawn. max_distance=5 ensures the player must actually walk north to the torch rather than just facing it from spawn (10 blocks away exceeds the 5-block threshold). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Jungle log pillars are centered at spawn-relative (13, 1, 0), approximately 13 blocks east of spawn. max_distance=5 requires the player to navigate to the eastern area to be within range.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The dark oak button is at spawn-relative (-10, 2, -4) above the corridor doorway on a stone brick wall, approximately 10.8 blocks from spawn. max_distance=4 ensures the player walked to the western wall and is close enough to see/interact with the button at y=2 (placed above the 2-tall doorway opening).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The smooth red sandstone stairs begin at spawn-relative (-10, 0, 8), approximately 12.8 blocks from spawn in the southwest. max_distance=4 requires the player to navigate to the staircase entrance.

Uses position_near_with_facing with tight max_distance=2 because the hopper is at spawn-relative (0, -3, -14) deep underground. Being within 2 blocks at y=-3 proves the player descended the stairway and reached the hopper room (the only reason to be at that exact underground location). facing_tolerance=45 ensures they are oriented toward the hopper for interaction.

Uses inventory_has because the player must retrieve cooked_chicken from the chest at (1,-3,-15) in the underground hopper room. The chest contains 5 cooked_chicken. The scene applies a hunger effect (amplifier 5, 5 seconds) so eating is possible and incentivized. Even after eating 1-4 pieces, the player will retain at least 1 in inventory. This is the best available proxy for consumption given rule type constraints — obtaining the item from a remote underground chest demonstrates significant task progress.

Uses inventory_has because mining fully-grown wheat (age=7) drops wheat items into the player's inventory. The player starts with no wheat. The wheat farm is at spawn-relative (15-19, 1, -2 to 2). Having at least 1 wheat confirms successful harvesting from the farm.

Uses count_in_box_at_most with kind=mob, max_count=0 because hunting means killing the donkey. The donkey is penned at spawn-relative (14, 1, 5) in a fenced area (12-16, 1, 3-7). The bounding box extends a few blocks beyond the pen to account for any movement before death while remaining tight enough to avoid false positives.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The magenta stained glass windows line the corridor walls from spawn-relative (-12 to -15, 1-2, -5). Target is the center of the glass array. max_distance=4 ensures the player has entered the corridor (past the button wall at x=-10) to be close enough.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cobblestone stairs are at spawn-relative (-10, -3, 11) underground. max_distance=4 combined with the target being at y=-3 ensures the player has descended past the red sandstone stairs to reach the cobblestone section — this cannot be satisfied from the surface.

Uses inventory_has because cooking raw rabbit produces cooked_rabbit which the player retrieves into inventory. The furnace is pre-loaded with raw rabbit and coal at CookTime:180/200 (completes within ~1 second of chunk loading). The player needs to reach the underground crafting room and take the cooked_rabbit from the furnace output slot. The player starts with no cooked_rabbit.

milestones.task: trade for Any color blank banner
milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because completing the villager trade (3 emeralds → 1 white_banner) places the banner in the player's inventory. The player starts with 10 emeralds and no banners. The shepherd villager at spawn-relative (-18, 0, -4) has a forced trade offering white_banner. Having at least 1 white_banner confirms successful trade completion.
